_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. namespace = the fixed namespace the <Namespace> placeholder is substituted for; placeholders = the skill's other placeholders, resolved to values that exist in the reference instance; assets = the chosen-approach files to include (Approach A: IContentLastChanceFinder — Approach B is config-only, so there is no C# to compile). requires = the content shape this example needs in order to prove anything, asserted by ReferenceContentPreconditionsTests; a <Placeholder> entry is resolved through placeholders above, so the alias is declared in exactly one place.
